deploymentBinding.sourceOfTruth: Resolved approved environment-variable values for the seven definitions above; no separately maintained hand-written plug-in values.
deploymentBinding.input: Exactly one schema-name/value pair for every definition, the separate result-writer user GUID, and SecurityVersion=2 bindings for OrganizationId, RequesterUserId, RequesterRoleId, TaId and LocationId. Verify actual IDs; no credential inputs. Requester must differ from writer and hold the exact configured effective role. No environment-specific values are committed.
deploymentBinding.businessHours: JSON object keyed by weekday name; exactly opens and closes string properties in HH:mm format per configured day. Missing days mean closed. Reject duplicate days/properties and unknown properties.
deploymentBinding.domains: Comma-separated canonical lowercase DNS domains without trailing dot; separator whitespace is ignored; duplicates reject.
deploymentBinding.durations: Comma-separated positive minutes, maximum 480, each divisible by 15; duplicates reject. List order is preserved.
deploymentBinding.output: Canonical seven-value rendering followed by six ordered security binding keys; LF line endings, no trailing newline. All guard steps receive the exact same rendered bytes.
validation: Missing, duplicate, unknown or empty environment settings reject.
Only the seven environment definitions and exact versioned nonsecret security bindings are accepted; credential/secret inputs reject.
Maximum horizon is 1-61; durations are multiples of 15; MaxCandidates is 1-200 and no greater than the slot limit.
Rendered output must parse through the real PluginConfiguration.Parse.
Parsed identity, domain/duration lists, scalar values, and every business-hour boundary must equal the source semantics exactly.
The real parser rejects unknown and duplicate keys, including case-insensitive duplicates.
Change approved environment values, then re-render; never hand-edit unsecure configuration.

notes: Example values are shape-only and are not environment configuration.
Environment configuration and verified security bindings -> AvailabilityConfigurationRenderer.RenderSecured -> plug-in unsecure configuration. Legacy Render alone cannot authorize guard execution.
No tenant, client, mailbox, credential, or secret value is included.
